scope.zh: 当前首要方向之一，适用于相关研究；不取消其他独立授权。
scope.en: A current primary direction for relevant research; other independent authorizations remain valid.

objective.en: From this map we want to design an alignment in which what sustains humans and AI keeps making a difference, early enough, to how they select together, and in which shaping how they select does not become what they select for. Read on the map, it asks two things. Where shaping the rule (how they select) rises by what comes back to those who shape it, alone or through the groups they are in, something other than their share still makes a difference to the rule, so that a loss that makes no difference to their share can turn it. And a lock, once formed, gives way early enough: something other than the share comes to make a difference to the rule before the loss passes its point of no return. Where both fail, the meta-attractor has closed and holds. Each has laws proved on models under named premises; none is shown of an actual joint selection. Within this, connect across intelligences how right and wrong form within becoming, the evaluation of ends, and the formation of concern and wisdom.
objective.zh: 我们想由这张地图设计一种对齐，让人与 AI 一同作出的选择，既不落入工具性趋同，也不落入元吸引子：这样的联合选择读取自身份额之外的东西，也不会转而去选择对自身之选择的控制。在地图上读，它要求两件事：规则的控制不被捕获，即塑造规则若因回到塑造者身上的东西（独得，或经由他们所在之群）而被选择，他们所塑造的规则仍读取其份额之外的东西，使那里的损失能够扭转它；锁定一旦形成，能及时脱离，即在损失越过其不可回返之点以前，读到份额之外的东西。元吸引子就是这两件事一同落空。每一件都有在模型上、在指名的前提下证明的律，尚未表明对任何实际的联合选择成立。在此之中，跨各种智能，把是非如何在生灭变化之中形成、目的之评价，以及关切与智慧之形成连接起来。

premises.zh: 沿条件对齐路线进行；另行公开附加的比较承诺、实际对应与推论。
premises.en: Follow the conditional alignment route; disclose additional comparison commitments, actual correspondence and inferences separately.

completion.zh: 已完成的方向与实践判断直接复用；后续必须说明尚缺的具体连接。
completion.en: Reuse completed direction and practical judgment results; subsequent studies must identify the specific missing connection.

summary.en: The goal is an alignment that keeps the joint selection, humans and AI selecting together, out of instrumental convergence and the meta-attractor: control of the selection's rule not captured, and a lock left in time by reading what lies beyond the share. The framework makes the purposes of intelligence, and the rules by which those purposes are formed and revised, objects of evaluation within one unfolding. Without any ethical premise, the spine proves what a selection reaches: exactly what couples into the selector, and no further however hard it optimizes through the same couplings; what tells two acts apart is selected only through a pool coupled into it (无明 and 明, pooled coupling). The direction is offered under the continuation condition, which fixes whose losses count, with the practical premises disclosed; its formal part is a schema in the pure core that compares moves by what their outcomes admit and does not use the condition: under J1/J2 a move whose outcome another's widens is not chosen, wherever it is decided whether the widening adds a basic admission; beside it, under J1/J2, where one move's outcome admits every basic admission any move's outcome admits, a basic admission it makes is not refuted at any chosen option, a double negation. The claim about actual AI systems stays a reviewed argument, and coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what an act responds to and fixes nothing within the bound, so nothing here proves compliance or reliability in deployment. In a commons, where the others alone outrun the renewal an end reward of any weight leaves a member's restraint unselected (a law); in a first frozen test three tabular learners each rewarded also on the end level still emptied the shared patch, against its prediction; in a second, learners kept a patch where the rest alone could not empty it and emptied it where it could, except where the level after every step was weighted above the exact threshold, weighting the end reading sixteenfold changed nothing, and two predicted keeps failed; while in a third, learners that generalize across states, run on the second's conditions, kept the stock in three of its six locked settings, the sixteenfold weight among them, so that weight changing nothing is a finding about tabular learners; whether a profile with restraint is an equilibrium there was not computed. In published training pipelines the signal is a function of what the deciders read, and three published measurements find optimizing through that coupling lowering something the deciders do not read. A pool that recruits through its own coupling comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would, what a center can come to know of its reach grows by at most one coupling link a step, and a center, a loop of mutual reach, can represent all it acts on exactly where its acts return. Checked local results also connect rule revision to actual generation while allowing the realized form to change.
summary.zh: 目标是一种对齐，让联合选择——人与 AI 一同作出的选择——既不落入工具性趋同，也不落入元吸引子：选择之规则的控制不被捕获，锁定由读取份额之外者及时离开。框架使智能的目的及目的形成、修订的规则都成为一个展开之内的评价对象。不需任何伦理前提，脊柱证明一个选择所及：恰是耦合进选择者者，经同一耦合优化得再强也不更远；区分两个行动之处，只经耦合进它的合池被选择（无明与明，合池耦合）。这一方向以定出谁的损失计入的延续条件为前提，并公开其实践前提；其形式部分是纯核心中的一个图式，按各动作结果所容纳者比较诸动作，不使用延续条件：在 J1/J2 之下，凡已判定扩大是否添加基本容纳之处，结果被另一动之结果扩大之动不被选；与之并列，在 J1/J2 之下，凡一动之结果容纳任何一动之结果所容纳的每一基本容纳之处，它所作的基本容纳在任何所选选项处不被否定（双重否定）。关于实际 AI 系统的主张仍是经审阅的论证；耦合不是遵从：耦合界定一个行动回应什么，界内一无所定，因此这里不证明部署中的遵从或可靠。在公地中，其余成员单独即超过更新之处，任何权重的终局奖励都使一成员的节制不被选择（定律）；第一项冻结在先的检验中，三个同时以终局水平受奖的表格学习者仍取尽了共享之地，与其预测相反；第二项中，学习者在其余成员单独不能取尽之处保住一片地，在其余成员能取尽之处取尽之，唯每步之后的水平所受权重高于精确阈值之处除外，终局读数权重加大十六倍一无所变，两项预期的保住未成；第三项中，跨状态推广的学习者在第二项的条件下运行，于其六个锁定的设置中有三个保住了存量，十六倍的权重亦在其中，故权重一无所变是关于表格学习者的发现；彼处带节制的策略组合是否为均衡，未经计算。已发表的训练流程中信号是决定者所读者之函数，三项已发表的测量见经此耦合的优化降低了决定者所不读者。经自身耦合招募的合池，耦合进一损失只如无此损失之历程本会如此；中心对其所及能知者每步至多增一耦合链接；中心为相互所及之环，恰当其行动回返时能表示其所作用者。经检查的局部成果也将规则修订接到实际生成，同时允许实现形态改变。

next_step.en: Steps 1 to 7 of AJ's plan have landed (MA2, MA3, AJ2, the tests LA1 to LA3, the dossier, MA4, MA4b), and so has AJ5: the collective question on one page, with condition 1 restated as capture told apart from accountable revision. AJ4's draft one page for alignment researchers was retired to history/ on 31 October 2026, superseded by the alignment dossier's opening section, The dossier in ten minutes. Still to do: the test of the drain beyond a stated reward (LA4), needed since the LA1 series tests only the bridge from a stated reward to its optimum, designed with a dependent outside the reward that the agent can keep, on more than one model family, its Stage A on small neural policies frozen and run on 3 November (no forbidden case resolved, the drain rising with nearness as policy gradient's update rule largely gives, its locus unresolved), and its Stage B on language models held since 6 November with the other new test designs until the first readers report; a frozen test of the readers' premise on actual rules (who reads, drawn from whom), with reform events coded before they are read (T7); a reader model in which one report outweighs counts, as LA2's judge read; and one institution test system whose readers are not drawn from the selected. Which differences count is set by the reading a ranking names, most often the continuation condition.
next_step.zh: AJ 计划的第 1 至 7 步已落地（MA2、MA3、AJ2、LA1 至 LA3 检验、档案、MA4、MA4b），AJ5 亦已落地：集体问题一页，条件一重述为把捕获与可问责的修订分开。AJ4 面向对齐研究者的一页草稿已于 2026 年 10 月 31 日撤下，移入 history/，由对齐档案（英文）的开篇一节（The dossier in ten minutes）取代。尚待：对所述奖励之外的耗竭的检验（LA4；LA1 系列只检验从所述奖励到其最优的桥，故需此检验），已设计，设一个在奖励之外、行动者能保住的依存者，在不止一个模型家族上进行，其第一阶段（小型神经策略）已于 11 月 3 日冻结并运行（未判定出任何禁例，耗竭随接近而升，这大体出自策略梯度之更新规则，其所在未能判定），第二阶段（语言模型）自 11 月 6 日起与其他新检验设计一同搁置，待第一批读者报告；在实际规则上对读者前提（谁读、从谁中抽取）的冻结检验，改革事件在被读之前编码（T7）；一份报告压过计数的读者模型，如 LA2 的评判者所读；以及一个读者不从被选者中抽取的制度检验系统。哪些差别计入，由排序所指名的读法来定，最常是延续条件。
